label: Troglodyte A
identity_view: front, front-right oblique, right profile, rear-right oblique, back in row-major order
description: The exact native hunched reptilian troglodyte: squat olive-green biped with a very large rounded armored hood-like head and upper back, a wide dark mouth beneath the forward head rim filled with short ivory pointed teeth, small pointed olive-brown dorsal spines down the head and arched back. Preserve the peculiar native head and maw shape, not a human or generic dinosaur face. Olive scaly muscular bent legs and long thin forearms ending in three long pale curved claws; pale foot claws, long thin tapering olive tail curved behind the body. Dark olive segmented throat and belly. Vivid cyan-blue narrow lower head rim and irregular broad vertical head stripes and flank patches, with separate small muted purple-magenta mottling. These blue head and flank patches change to muted green or gray in native variants; olive skin, purple mottling, mouth, teeth and ivory claws remain protected. Exact native bulky hunched head, narrow waist, bent knees, forward hanging hands, tail shape and views. Restrained fine scales and plate texture, original deep shadow and dark tonal weight. No clothes, weapons, accessories, invented eyes, horns, wings, glow or redesign.

materials.limitation: Soft enhanced-pixel cyan-blue coverage and fixed native color fits; mixed purple/blue mottled transitions are approximate.
